name: Rasa Juknevičienė - § 64 - Am 9
title: REPORT on Hybrid warfare and the protection of the EU’s territorial integrity and critical security and defence infrastructure
part_text: 64. Strongly condemns the instrumentalisation of migration by third countries or hostile non-state actors in order to destabilise a Member State or put pressure on the EU; considers the new provisions on the instrumentalisation of migration recently included in EU legislation to be manifestly insufficient; calls for their urgent review in order to ensure that Member States facing hybrid attacks involving the instrumentalisation of illegal immigration are able to ensure the immediate and effective return of those instrumentalised persons; notes the Commission’s announced revision of the mandate for Frontex; underlines that this revision should provide for the legal basis, analytical capabilities, and adequate human, financial and technical resources required, which would also help strengthen the EU’s response to hybrid threats; calls on the Member States to strengthen the effective control of their external borders and cooperation between police, intelligence, customs and border guard services, and to reinforce their operational capacity to detect, prevent and respond to coordinated actions aimed at provoking or exploiting illegal immigration crises as part of hybrid operations;
